label: IFRS Global Core Chart of Accounts
description: Standalone IFRS-oriented global chart of accounts baseline for Reados account segments. It is not derived from Turkey Tek Düzen or another jurisdictional uniform chart.

metadata.intendedUse: Adopt as a production baseline, then tailor for entity-specific materiality, industry, regulatory and management-reporting needs before posting live transactions.

members.name: Assets
